text: In 1891, a camera called the Kinetograph made pictures move.
Today, to make a video with code, a browser screenshots every single frame.
With Kinetograph, you don't need one.
You just render. Straight on the GPU.
Your demo. Your launch. Your changelog.
Write it in code, and it renders.
Even glass that bends the light.
Already using Remotion? Your projects run as they are.
This whole film rendered in twenty-seven seconds.
No browser. No screenshots. Just pixels.
Kinetograph. Motion pictures, written in code. Try it at kinetograph.dev.
